一元线性回归

回归模型的一般形式：

y=β0+β1x1+εy = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_1 + \varepsilon y=β0​+β1​x1​+ε

β0\beta_0β0​ 和 β1\beta_1β1​ 是常数，ε\varepsilonε 是随机误差项，对 nnn 组样本观测值 (xi,yi), i=1,2,3,⋯ ,n(x_i, y_i),\, i=1,2,3,\cdots,n(xi​,yi​),i=1,2,3,⋯,n，有：

yi=β0+β1xi+εi,i=1,2,3,⋯ ,ny_i = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i + \varepsilon_i,\quad i=1,2,3,\cdots,n yi​=β0​+β1​xi​+εi​,i=1,2,3,⋯,n

下面假定：

  1. xix_ixi​ 是确定性变量（所有随机性都来自 ε\varepsilonε）
  2. 满足 Gauss-Markov 条件：E(εi)=0E(\varepsilon_i)=0E(εi​)=0，Cov(εi,εj)=δijσ2, i,j=1,2,⋯ ,n\text{Cov}(\varepsilon_i,\varepsilon_j)=\delta_{ij}\sigma^2,\, i,j=1,2,\cdots,nCov(εi​,εj​)=δij​σ2,i,j=1,2,⋯,n
  3. 正态分布假设：εi∼iidN(0,σ2)\varepsilon_i \overset{\text{iid}}{\sim} N(0,\sigma^2)εi​∼iidN(0,σ2)

在上面的假设下 yyy 服从正态分布：

E(yi)=β0+β1xi,Var(yi)=σ2,yi∼N(β0+β1xi,σ2),i=1,2,…,nE(y_i) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i,\quad \mathrm{Var}(y_i) = \sigma^2,\quad y_i \sim N(\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i, \sigma^2),\quad i=1,2,\dots,n E(yi​)=β0​+β1​xi​,Var(yi​)=σ2,yi​∼N(β0​+β1​xi​,σ2),i=1,2,…,n

注：由 εi\varepsilon_iεi​ 之间的相互独立性可知 yiy_iyi​ 是相互独立的，但 yiy_iyi​ 不是同分布的。

为了描述数据的系统性规律，现在想要建立回归方程：

E(y∣x)=β0+β1xE(y \mid x) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x E(y∣x)=β0​+β1​x

回归分析的主要任务就是通过 nnn 组样本观测值 (xi,yi) (i=1,2,…,n)(x_i, y_i)\ (i=1,2,\dots,n)(xi​,yi​) (i=1,2,…,n)，对 β0,β1\beta_0, \beta_1β0​,β1​ 进行估计。一般用 β^0,β^1\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1β^​0​,β^​1​ 分别表示 β0,β1\beta_0, \beta_1β0​,β1​ 的估计值，则称

y^=β^0+β^1x(2.7)\hat{y} = \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x \tag{2.7} y^​=β^​0​+β^​1​x(2.7)

为 yyy 关于 xxx 的一元线性经验回归方程。

注：

  • 残差 eie_iei​：观测值与预测值之差，即 ei=yi−y^ie_i = y_i - \hat{y}_iei​=yi​−y^​i​
  • 将残差 eie_iei​ 作为误差项 εi\varepsilon_iεi​ 的估计值，即 ε^i=ei\hat{\varepsilon}_i = e_iε^i​=ei​
  • 总离差平方和（Total Sum of Squares）：反映 yyy 总的波动

    SST=∑i=1n(yi−yˉ)2SST = \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2 SST=i=1∑n​(yi​−yˉ​)2

  • 回归平方和（Regression Sum of Squares）：反映由 xxx 的线性关系解释的那部分波动

    SSR=∑i=1n(y^i−yˉ)2SSR = \sum_{i=1}^n (\hat{y}_i - \bar{y})^2 SSR=i=1∑n​(y^​i​−yˉ​)2

  • 残差平方和（Error Sum of Squares）：反映回归模型未能解释的随机波动

    SSE=∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2SSE = \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2 SSE=i=1∑n​(yi​−y^​i​)2

  • 总离差平方和（SST）可分解为回归平方和（SSR）与残差平方和（SSE）之和，即 SST=SSR+SSESST = SSR + SSESST=SSR+SSE

    ∑i=1n(yi−yˉ)2=∑i=1n(y^i−yˉ)2+∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2\sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2 = \sum_{i=1}^n (\hat{y}_i - \bar{y})^2 + \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2 i=1∑n​(yi​−yˉ​)2=i=1∑n​(y^​i​−yˉ​)2+i=1∑n​(yi​−y^​i​)2

参数估计

普通最小二乘估计 OLSE

普通最小二乘估计（Ordinary Least Square Estimation, OLSE）：对每一个样本观测值 (xi,yi)(x_i, y_i)(xi​,yi​)，考虑观测值 yiy_iyi​ 与其回归值 E(yi)=β0+β1xiE(y_i) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_iE(yi​)=β0​+β1​xi​ 的离差平方和最小：

arg⁡min⁡β^0,β^1Q(β^0,β^1)=∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2=∑i=1n(yi−β^0−β^1xi)2\underset{\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1}{\arg\min} Q(\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \hat{\beta}_0 - \hat{\beta}_1 x_i)^2 β^​0​,β^​1​argmin​Q(β^​0​,β^​1​)=i=1∑n​(yi​−y^​i​)2=i=1∑n​(yi​−β^​0​−β^​1​xi​)2

  • y^i=β^0+β^1xi\hat{y}_i = \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_iy^​i​=β^​0​+β^​1​xi​：yiy_iyi​ 的回归拟合值（回归值、拟合值）
  • ei=yi−y^ie_i = y_i - \hat{y}_iei​=yi​−y^​i​：yiy_iyi​ 的残差

令目标函数的偏导数为 0：

{∂Q∂β0∣β0=β^0=−2∑i=1n(yi−β^0−β^1xi)=0,∂Q∂β1∣β1=β^1=−2∑i=1n(yi−β^0−β^1xi)xi=0⇒{∑i=1nei=0∑i=1nxiei=0\begin{cases} \left. \dfrac{\partial Q}{\partial \beta_0} \right|_{\beta_0 = \hat{\beta}_0} = -2 \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( y_i - \hat{\beta}_0 - \hat{\beta}_1 x_i \right) = 0, \\[8pt] \left. \dfrac{\partial Q}{\partial \beta_1} \right|_{\beta_1 = \hat{\beta}_1} = -2 \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( y_i - \hat{\beta}_0 - \hat{\beta}_1 x_i \right) x_i = 0 \end{cases} \Rightarrow \color{blue}\left\{ \begin{aligned} \sum_{i=1}^{n} e_i &= 0 \\ \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i e_i &= 0 \end{aligned} \right. ⎩⎪⎪⎪⎨⎪⎪⎪⎧​∂β0​∂Q​∣∣∣∣​β0​=β^​0​​=−2i=1∑n​(yi​−β^​0​−β^​1​xi​)=0,∂β1​∂Q​∣∣∣∣​β1​=β^​1​​=−2i=1∑n​(yi​−β^​0​−β^​1​xi​)xi​=0​⇒⎩⎪⎪⎪⎪⎨⎪⎪⎪⎪⎧​i=1∑n​ei​i=1∑n​xi​ei​​=0=0​

化简得到正规方程组：

{nβ^0+(∑i=1nxi)β^1=∑i=1nyi,(∑i=1nxi)β^0+(∑i=1nxi2)β^1=∑i=1nxiyi\begin{cases} n \hat{\beta}_0 + \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right) \hat{\beta}_1 = \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i, \\[8pt] \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right) \hat{\beta}_0 + \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2 \right) \hat{\beta}_1 = \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i y_i \end{cases} ⎩⎪⎪⎪⎪⎨⎪⎪⎪⎪⎧​nβ^​0​+(i=1∑n​xi​)β^​1​=i=1∑n​yi​,(i=1∑n​xi​)β^​0​+(i=1∑n​xi2​)β^​1​=i=1∑n​xi​yi​​

解正规方程组得参数估计量：

⇒{β^0=yˉ−β^1xˉ,β^1=n∑i=1nxiyi−(∑i=1nyi)(∑i=1nxi)n∑i=1nxi2−(∑i=1nxi)2=∑i=1nxiyi−1n(∑i=1nyi)(∑i=1nxi)∑i=1nxi2−n(xˉ)2\Rightarrow \quad \begin{cases} \hat{\beta}_0 = \bar{y} - \hat{\beta}_1 \bar{x}, \\[10pt] \hat{\beta}_1 = \dfrac{n \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i y_i - \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i \right) \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right)}{n \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2 - \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right)^2} = \dfrac{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i y_i - \dfrac{1}{n} \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i \right) \left( \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right)}{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2 - n \left( \bar{x} \right)^2} \end{cases} ⇒⎩⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎨⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎧​β^​0​=yˉ​−β^​1​xˉ,β^​1​=ni=1∑n​xi2​−(i=1∑n​xi​)2ni=1∑n​xi​yi​−(i=1∑n​yi​)(i=1∑n​xi​)​=i=1∑n​xi2​−n(xˉ)2i=1∑n​xi​yi​−n1​(i=1∑n​yi​)(i=1∑n​xi​)​​

注意到：

yˉ∑i=1nxi=nxˉyˉ=xˉ∑i=1nyi,∑i=1nxˉxi=n(xˉ)2\bar{y} \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i = n \bar{x} \bar{y} = \bar{x} \sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i, \quad \sum_{i=1}^{n} \bar{x} x_i = n (\bar{x})^2 yˉ​i=1∑n​xi​=nxˉyˉ​=xˉi=1∑n​yi​,i=1∑n​xˉxi​=n(xˉ)2

引入记号：

Lxx=∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)2=∑i=1nxi2−n(xˉ)2=∑i=1nxi2−1n(∑i=1nxi)2L_{xx} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( x_i - \bar{x} \right)^2 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2 - n \left( \bar{x} \right)^2 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i^2 - \dfrac{1}{n} \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right)^2 Lxx​=i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)2=i=1∑n​xi2​−n(xˉ)2=i=1∑n​xi2​−n1​(i=1∑n​xi​)2

Lxy=∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)(yi−yˉ)=∑i=1nxiyi−nxˉyˉ=∑i=1nxiyi−1n(∑i=1nxi)(∑i=1nyi)L_{xy} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( x_i - \bar{x} \right) \left( y_i - \bar{y} \right) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i y_i - n \bar{x} \bar{y} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i y_i - \dfrac{1}{n} \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i \right) \left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i \right) Lxy​=i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)(yi​−yˉ​)=i=1∑n​xi​yi​−nxˉyˉ​=i=1∑n​xi​yi​−n1​(i=1∑n​xi​)(i=1∑n​yi​)

最终简化为等价形式：

⇒{β^0=1n∑i=1nyi−β^1⋅1n∑i=1nxi,β^1=LxyLxx=∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)(yi−yˉ)∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)2\Rightarrow \quad \begin{cases} \hat{\beta}_0 = \dfrac{1}{n} \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} y_i - \hat{\beta}_1 \cdot \dfrac{1}{n} \displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_i, \\[10pt] \hat{\beta}_1 = \dfrac{L_{xy}}{L_{xx}} = \dfrac{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( x_i - \bar{x} \right) \left( y_i - \bar{y} \right)}{\displaystyle\sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( x_i - \bar{x} \right)^2} \end{cases} ⇒⎩⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎨⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎪⎧​β^​0​=n1​i=1∑n​yi​−β^​1​⋅n1​i=1∑n​xi​,β^​1​=Lxx​Lxy​​=i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)2i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)(yi​−yˉ​)​​

最小二乘估计性质

1. β^0,β^1\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1β^​0​,β^​1​ 是 Y1,Y2,…,YnY_1, Y_2, \dots, Y_nY1​,Y2​,…,Yn​ 的线性函数：

β^1=LxyLxx=∑i=1nxi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2Yi\hat{\beta}_1 = \frac{L_{xy}}{L_{xx}} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} Y_i β^​1​=Lxx​Lxy​​=i=1∑n​∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​Yi​

β^0=Yˉ−β^1xˉ=∑i=1n1nYi−∑i=1nxˉ(xi−xˉ)∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2Yi\hat{\beta}_0 = \bar{Y} - \hat{\beta}_1 \bar{x} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{n} Y_i - \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{\bar{x}(x_i - \bar{x})}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} Y_i β^​0​=Yˉ−β^​1​xˉ=i=1∑n​n1​Yi​−i=1∑n​∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xˉ(xi​−xˉ)​Yi​

2. β^1\hat{\beta}_1β^​1​ 是 β1\beta_1β1​ 的无偏估计，β^0\hat{\beta}_0β^​0​ 是 β0\beta_0β0​ 的无偏估计，回归值 y^\hat{y}y^​ 是 E(y)E(y)E(y) 的无偏估计

E(β^1)=∑i=1nxi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2E(Yi)=∑i=1nxi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2(β0+β1xi)=1Lxx[β0∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)+β1∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)xi]=1Lxxβ1Lxx=β1\begin{aligned} E(\hat{\beta}_1) &= \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} E(Y_i) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i) \\ &= \frac{1}{L_{xx}} \left[ \beta_0 \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x}) + \beta_1 \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x}) x_i \right] = \frac{1}{L_{xx}} \beta_1 L_{xx} = \beta_1 \end{aligned} E(β^​1​)​=i=1∑n​∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​E(Yi​)=i=1∑n​∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​(β0​+β1​xi​)=Lxx​1​[β0​i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)+β1​i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)xi​]=Lxx​1​β1​Lxx​=β1​​

E(β^0)=∑i=1n1nE(Yi)−E(β^1)xˉ=∑i=1n1n(β0+β1xi)−β1xˉ=β0E(\hat{\beta}_0) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{n} E(Y_i) - E(\hat{\beta}_1) \bar{x} = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{n} (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i) - \beta_1 \bar{x} = \beta_0 E(β^​0​)=i=1∑n​n1​E(Yi​)−E(β^​1​)xˉ=i=1∑n​n1​(β0​+β1​xi​)−β1​xˉ=β0​

E(y^)=E(β^0+β^1xi)=β0+β1xi=E(y)E(\hat{y}) = E(\hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_i) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i = E(y) E(y^​)=E(β^​0​+β^​1​xi​)=β0​+β1​xi​=E(y)

3. β^0,β^1\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1β^​0​,β^​1​ 的方差：

Var(β^1)=∑i=1n[xi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2]2Var(Yi)=σ2Lxx\text{Var}(\hat{\beta}_1) = \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left[ \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} \right]^2 \text{Var}(Y_i) = \frac{\sigma^2}{L_{xx}} Var(β^​1​)=i=1∑n​[∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​]2Var(Yi​)=Lxx​σ2​

Var(β^0)={∑i=1n1n2+∑i=1n[xˉ(xi−xˉ)∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2]2}σ2=(1n+(xˉ)2Lxx)σ2\text{Var}(\hat{\beta}_0) = \left\{ \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{1}{n^2} + \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left[ \frac{\bar{x}(x_i - \bar{x})}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} \right]^2 \right\} \sigma^2 = \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(\bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 Var(β^​0​)=⎩⎨⎧​i=1∑n​n21​+i=1∑n​[∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xˉ(xi​−xˉ)​]2⎭⎬⎫​σ2=(n1​+Lxx​(xˉ)2​)σ2

Cov(β^0,β^1)=Cov(∑i=1n(1n−xˉ(xi−xˉ)∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2)Yi,∑i=1nxi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2Yi)=Yi 独立∑i=1n(1n−xˉ(xi−xˉ)∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2)(xi−xˉ∑j=1n(xj−xˉ)2)Var(Yi)=[1nLxx∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)−xˉLxx2∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)2]σ2=−xˉLxxσ2\begin{aligned} \text{Cov}(\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1) &= \text{Cov}\left( \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{\bar{x}(x_i - \bar{x})}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} \right) Y_i, \sum_{i=1}^{n} \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} Y_i \right) \\ &\xlongequal{Y_i \text{ 独立}} \sum_{i=1}^{n} \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{\bar{x}(x_i - \bar{x})}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} \right) \left( \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{\sum_{j=1}^{n} (x_j - \bar{x})^2} \right) \text{Var}(Y_i) \\ &= \left[ \frac{1}{n L_{xx}} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x}) - \frac{\bar{x}}{L_{xx}^2} \sum_{i=1}^{n} (x_i - \bar{x})^2 \right] \sigma^2 = -\frac{\bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \sigma^2 \end{aligned} Cov(β^​0​,β^​1​)​=Cov(i=1∑n​(n1​−∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xˉ(xi​−xˉ)​)Yi​,i=1∑n​∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​Yi​)Yi​ 独立i=1∑n​(n1​−∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xˉ(xi​−xˉ)​)(∑j=1n​(xj​−xˉ)2xi​−xˉ​)Var(Yi​)=[nLxx​1​i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)−Lxx2​xˉ​i=1∑n​(xi​−xˉ)2]σ2=−Lxx​xˉ​σ2​

在正态假设下：

β^0∼N(β0,(1n+(xˉ)2Lxx)σ2),β^1∼N(β1,σ2Lxx)\hat{\beta}_0 \sim N\left( \beta_0, \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(\bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 \right), \quad \hat{\beta}_1 \sim N\left( \beta_1, \frac{\sigma^2}{L_{xx}} \right) β^​0​∼N(β0​,(n1​+Lxx​(xˉ)2​)σ2),β^​1​∼N(β1​,Lxx​σ2​)

4. β^0\hat{\beta}_0β^​0​ 和 β^1\hat{\beta}_1β^​1​ 分别是 β0\beta_0β0​ 与 β1\beta_1β1​ 的最佳线性无偏估计（BLUE）（在 Gauss-Markov 条件下）。

最大似然估计

假设 εi∼N(0,σ2)\varepsilon_i \sim N(0, \sigma^2)εi​∼N(0,σ2)，yi∼N(β0+β1xi1,σ2)y_i \sim N(\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{i1}, \sigma^2)yi​∼N(β0​+β1​xi1​,σ2)，似然函数：

L(β0,β1,σ2)=∏i=1nfi(yi)=(2πσ2)−n2exp⁡{−12σ2∑i=1n[yi−(β0+β1xi1)]2}L(\beta_0, \beta_1, \sigma^2) = \prod_{i=1}^n f_i(y_i) = (2\pi\sigma^2)^{-\frac{n}{2}} \exp\left\{ -\frac{1}{2\sigma^2} \sum_{i=1}^n \left[y_i - (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{i1})\right]^2 \right\} L(β0​,β1​,σ2)=i=1∏n​fi​(yi​)=(2πσ2)−2n​exp{−2σ21​i=1∑n​[yi​−(β0​+β1​xi1​)]2}

ln⁡L=−n2ln⁡(2πσ2)−12σ2∑i=1n[yi−(β0+β1xi1)]2\ln L = -\frac{n}{2} \ln(2\pi\sigma^2) - \frac{1}{2\sigma^2} \sum_{i=1}^n \left[y_i - (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{i1})\right]^2 lnL=−2n​ln(2πσ2)−2σ21​i=1∑n​[yi​−(β0​+β1​xi1​)]2

arg⁡max⁡β0,β1ln⁡L=arg⁡min⁡β0,β1∑i=1n[yi−(β0+β1xi1)]2,\arg\max_{\beta_0, \beta_1} \ln L = \arg\min_{\beta_0, \beta_1} \sum_{i=1}^n \left[y_i - (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{i1})\right]^2, argβ0​,β1​max​lnL=argβ0​,β1​min​i=1∑n​[yi​−(β0​+β1​xi1​)]2,

故 β^0,β^1\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1β^​0​,β^​1​ 的极大似然估计与最小二乘估计相同。

∂ln⁡L∂σ2=−n2σ2+12σ4∑i=1n[yi−(β0+β1xi1)]2=0,\frac{\partial \ln L}{\partial \sigma^2} = -\frac{n}{2\sigma^2} + \frac{1}{2\sigma^4} \sum_{i=1}^n \left[y_i - (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_{i1})\right]^2 = 0, ∂σ2∂lnL​=−2σ2n​+2σ41​i=1∑n​[yi​−(β0​+β1​xi1​)]2=0,

得 σ^2=1n∑i=1n[yi−(β^0+β^1xi1)]2=1n∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2\hat{\sigma}^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n \left[y_i - (\hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_{i1})\right]^2 = \frac{1}{n} \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2σ^2=n1​∑i=1n​[yi​−(β^​0​+β^​1​xi1​)]2=n1​∑i=1n​(yi​−y^​i​)2。

回归方程显著性检验

注：判断是否拒绝原假设，也可以利用 ttt 分布和 ttt 统计量的值，计算概率 P(∣t∣>∣t值∣)P(|t| > |t\text{值}|)P(∣t∣>∣t值∣)，这一概率值又被称为 PPP 值，即

P(∣t∣>∣t值∣)=P值P(|t| > |t\text{值}|) = P\text{值} P(∣t∣>∣t值∣)=P值

易知：∣t值∣|t\text{值}|∣t值∣ 越大，PPP 值越小；∣t值∣|t\text{值}|∣t值∣ 越小，PPP 值越大。

因此，对于给定的显著性水平 α\alphaα，当 PPP 值 <α< \alpha<α 时，拒绝原假设。在给定显著性水平的情况下，使用 PPP 值不需要查分布表可以直接判断是否拒绝原假设。

ttt 检验

H0:β1=0versusH1:β1≠0H_0: \beta_1 = 0 \quad \text{versus} \quad H_1: \beta_1 \neq 0 H0​:β1​=0versusH1​:β1​​=0

由于

β^1∼H0N(0,σ2Lxx)\hat{\beta}_1 \overset{H_0}{\sim} N\left(0, \frac{\sigma^2}{L_{xx}}\right) β^​1​∼H0​N(0,Lxx​σ2​)

可取检验统计量

t=β^1σ^2/Lxx=β^1σ^2/Lxx∼H0t(n−2)t = \frac{\hat{\beta}_1}{\sqrt{\hat{\sigma}^2 / L_{xx}}} = \frac{\hat{\beta}_1}{\sqrt{\hat{\sigma}^2 / L_{xx}}} \overset{H_0}{\sim} t(n-2) t=σ^2/Lxx​​β^​1​​=σ^2/Lxx​​β^​1​​∼H0​t(n−2)

σ^2=1n−2∑i=1nei2=1n−2∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2\hat{\sigma}^2 = \frac{1}{n-2} \sum_{i=1}^n e_i^2 = \frac{1}{n-2} \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2 σ^2=n−21​i=1∑n​ei2​=n−21​i=1∑n​(yi​−y^​i​)2

显著性水平 α\alphaα，当 ∣t∣>tα/2(n−2)|t| > t_{\alpha/2}(n-2)∣t∣>tα/2​(n−2) 时，拒绝 H0H_0H0​，认为 β1\beta_1β1​ 显著不为零。

FFF 检验

∑i=1n(yi−yˉ)2=∑i=1n(y^i−yˉ)2+∑i=1n(yi−y^i)2\sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \bar{y})^2 = \sum_{i=1}^{n} (\hat{y}_i - \bar{y})^2 + \sum_{i=1}^{n} (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2 i=1∑n​(yi​−yˉ​)2=i=1∑n​(y^​i​−yˉ​)2+i=1∑n​(yi​−y^​i​)2

SST=SSR+SSESST = SSR + SSE SST=SSR+SSE

正态假设下，SSR 和 SSE 服从卡方分布。

取检验统计量

F=SSR/1SSE/(n−2),H0 成立时, F∼F(1,n−2)F = \frac{SSR/1}{SSE/(n-2)} ,\quad H_0 \text{ 成立时, } F \sim F(1,n-2) F=SSE/(n−2)SSR/1​,H0​ 成立时, F∼F(1,n−2)

给定显著性水平 α\alphaα，当 F>Fα(1,n−2)F > F_{\alpha}(1, n-2)F>Fα​(1,n−2) 时，拒绝 H0H_0H0​。

样本决定系数

SST=SSR+SSESST = SSR + SSE SST=SSR+SSE

正态假设下，SSR 和 SSE 服从卡方分布：

F=SSR/1SSE/(n−2)∼F(1,n−2)F = \frac{SSR / 1}{SSE / (n-2)} \sim F(1, n-2) F=SSE/(n−2)SSR/1​∼F(1,n−2)

当 FFF 值 >Fα(1,n−2)> F_{\alpha}(1, n-2)>Fα​(1,n−2) 时，拒绝 H0H_0H0​，回归方程显著。

相关系数显著性检验

样本相关系数（皮尔逊相关系数）

r=∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)(yi−yˉ)∑i=1n(xi−xˉ)2∑i=1n(yi−yˉ)2=LxyLxxLyyr = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar{x})(y_i - \bar{y})}{\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^n (x_i - \bar{x})^2 \sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2}} = \frac{L_{xy}}{\sqrt{L_{xx} L_{yy}}} r=∑i=1n​(xi​−xˉ)2∑i=1n​(yi​−yˉ​)2​∑i=1n​(xi​−xˉ)(yi​−yˉ​)​=Lxx​Lyy​​Lxy​​

由 Cauchy-Schwarz 不等式

(∑aibi)2≤(∑ai2)(∑bi2)\left(\sum a_i b_i\right)^2 \leq \left(\sum a_i^2\right)\left(\sum b_i^2\right) (∑ai​bi​)2≤(∑ai2​)(∑bi2​)

可知 ∣r∣≤1|r| \leq 1∣r∣≤1。

相关系数检验

H0:ρ=0versusH1:ρ≠0H_0: \rho = 0 \quad \text{versus} \quad H_1: \rho \neq 0 H0​:ρ=0versusH1​:ρ​=0

检验统计量

t=n−2 r1−r2∼t(n−2)t = \frac{\sqrt{n-2} \, r}{\sqrt{1-r^2}} \sim t(n-2) t=1−r2​n−2​r​∼t(n−2)

当 ∣t∣>tα/2(n−2)|t| > t_{\alpha/2}(n-2)∣t∣>tα/2​(n−2) 时，拒绝 H0H_0H0​，认为 rrr 显著不为零。

记总体相关系数为 ρ\rhoρ，样本相关系数 rrr 是 ρ\rhoρ 的估计值。

样本决定系数

r2=SSRSST=∑i=1n(y^i−yˉ)2∑i=1n(yi−yˉ)2r^2 = \frac{SSR}{SST} = \frac{\sum_{i=1}^n (\hat{y}_i - \bar{y})^2}{\sum_{i=1}^n (y_i - \bar{y})^2} r2=SSTSSR​=∑i=1n​(yi​−yˉ​)2∑i=1n​(y^​i​−yˉ​)2​

残差的性质

① 残差的期望：

E(ei)=E(yi−y^i)=E(yi)−E(y^i)=(β0+β1xi)−(β0+β1xi)=0.E(e_i) = E(y_i - \hat{y}_i) = E(y_i) - E(\hat{y}_i) = (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i) - (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_i) = 0. E(ei​)=E(yi​−y^​i​)=E(yi​)−E(y^​i​)=(β0​+β1​xi​)−(β0​+β1​xi​)=0.

② 误差项与估计量的协方差：

Cov(εi,β^0)=Cov(εi,∑j=1n(1n−xj−xˉLxxxˉ)yj)=∑j=1nCov(εi,(1n−xj−xˉLxxxˉ)(β0+β1xj+εj))=∑j=1nCov(εi,(1n−xj−xˉLxxxˉ)εj)=(1n−xi−xˉLxxxˉ)σ2,Cov(εi,β^1)=Cov(εi,∑j=1nxj−xˉLxxyj)=∑j=1nCov(εi,xj−xˉLxxyj)=xi−xˉLxxσ2.\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Cov}(\varepsilon_i, \hat{\beta}_0) &= \mathrm{Cov}\left( \varepsilon_i, \sum_{j=1}^n \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{x_j - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \bar{x} \right) y_j \right) \\ &= \sum_{j=1}^n \mathrm{Cov}\left( \varepsilon_i, \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{x_j - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \bar{x} \right) (\beta_0 + \beta_1 x_j + \varepsilon_j) \right) \\ &= \sum_{j=1}^n \mathrm{Cov}\left( \varepsilon_i, \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{x_j - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \bar{x} \right) \varepsilon_j \right) \\ &= \left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \bar{x} \right) \sigma^2, \\[2em] \mathrm{Cov}(\varepsilon_i, \hat{\beta}_1) &= \mathrm{Cov}\left( \varepsilon_i, \sum_{j=1}^n \frac{x_j - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} y_j \right) \\ &= \sum_{j=1}^n \mathrm{Cov}\left( \varepsilon_i, \frac{x_j - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} y_j \right) \\ &= \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \sigma^2. \end{aligned} Cov(εi​,β^​0​)Cov(εi​,β^​1​)​=Cov(εi​,j=1∑n​(n1​−Lxx​xj​−xˉ​xˉ)yj​)=j=1∑n​Cov(εi​,(n1​−Lxx​xj​−xˉ​xˉ)(β0​+β1​xj​+εj​))=j=1∑n​Cov(εi​,(n1​−Lxx​xj​−xˉ​xˉ)εj​)=(n1​−Lxx​xi​−xˉ​xˉ)σ2,=Cov(εi​,j=1∑n​Lxx​xj​−xˉ​yj​)=j=1∑n​Cov(εi​,Lxx​xj​−xˉ​yj​)=Lxx​xi​−xˉ​σ2.​

③ 残差的方差：

Var(ei)=Var(yi−y^i)=Var(εi−(β^0+β^1xi))=Var(εi)+Var(β^0+β^1xi)−2Cov(εi,β^0+β^1xi)=σ2+Var(β^0)+xi2Var(β^1)+2xiCov(β^0,β^1)−2Cov(εi,β^0)−2xiCov(εi,β^1)=σ2+(1n+(xˉ)2Lxx)σ2+xi2Lxxσ2+2xi(−xˉLxx)σ2−2(1n−xi−xˉLxxxˉ)σ2−2xi−xˉLxxxiσ2=(1−1n−(xi−xˉ)2Lxx)σ2≜(1−hii)σ2,\begin{aligned} \mathrm{Var}(e_i) &= \mathrm{Var}(y_i - \hat{y}_i) \\ &= \mathrm{Var}\bigl( \varepsilon_i - (\hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_i) \bigr) \\ &= \mathrm{Var}(\varepsilon_i) + \mathrm{Var}(\hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_i) - 2\mathrm{Cov}\bigl( \varepsilon_i, \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_i \bigr) \\ &= \sigma^2 + \mathrm{Var}(\hat{\beta}_0) + x_i^2 \mathrm{Var}(\hat{\beta}_1) + 2x_i \mathrm{Cov}(\hat{\beta}_0, \hat{\beta}_1) \\ &\qquad - 2\mathrm{Cov}(\varepsilon_i, \hat{\beta}_0) - 2x_i \mathrm{Cov}(\varepsilon_i, \hat{\beta}_1) \\ &= \sigma^2 + \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(\bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 + \frac{x_i^2}{L_{xx}} \sigma^2 + 2x_i \left( -\frac{\bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 \\ &\qquad - 2\left( \frac{1}{n} - \frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} \bar{x} \right) \sigma^2 - 2\frac{x_i - \bar{x}}{L_{xx}} x_i \sigma^2 \\[0.5em] &= \left( 1 - \frac{1}{n} - \frac{(x_i - \bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 \\ &\triangleq (1 - h_{ii}) \sigma^2, \end{aligned} Var(ei​)​=Var(yi​−y^​i​)=Var(εi​−(β^​0​+β^​1​xi​))=Var(εi​)+Var(β^​0​+β^​1​xi​)−2Cov(εi​,β^​0​+β^​1​xi​)=σ2+Var(β^​0​)+xi2​Var(β^​1​)+2xi​Cov(β^​0​,β^​1​)−2Cov(εi​,β^​0​)−2xi​Cov(εi​,β^​1​)=σ2+(n1​+Lxx​(xˉ)2​)σ2+Lxx​xi2​​σ2+2xi​(−Lxx​xˉ​)σ2−2(n1​−Lxx​xi​−xˉ​xˉ)σ2−2Lxx​xi​−xˉ​xi​σ2=(1−n1​−Lxx​(xi​−xˉ)2​)σ2≜(1−hii​)σ2,​

其中杠杆值 hii=1n+(xi−xˉ)2Lxx\displaystyle h_{ii} = \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(x_i - \bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}}hii​=n1​+Lxx​(xi​−xˉ)2​。

④ 残差的约束条件：

∑i=1nei=0,∑i=1nxiei=0.\sum_{i=1}^n e_i = 0, \qquad \sum_{i=1}^n x_i e_i = 0. i=1∑n​ei​=0,i=1∑n​xi​ei​=0.

这意味着残差 e1,…,ene_1, \dots, e_ne1​,…,en​ 是相关的，并非相互独立。

标准化残差ZREi=eiσ^,学生化残差SREi=eiσ^1−hii.\begin{aligned} \text{标准化残差} &\quad \mathrm{ZRE}_i = \frac{e_i}{\hat{\sigma}}, \\ \text{学生化残差} &\quad \mathrm{SRE}_i = \frac{e_i}{\hat{\sigma}\sqrt{1-h_{ii}}}. \end{aligned} 标准化残差学生化残差​ZREi​=σ^ei​​,SREi​=σ^1−hii​​ei​​.​

⑥ 回归系数的区间估计：

由 β^1∼N(β1,σ2Lxx)\hat{\beta}_1 \sim N\left( \beta_1, \dfrac{\sigma^2}{L_{xx}} \right)β^​1​∼N(β1​,Lxx​σ2​)，可知

t=β^1−β1σ^2/Lxx=(β^1−β1)Lxxσ^∼t(n−2).t = \frac{\hat{\beta}_1 - \beta_1}{\sqrt{\hat{\sigma}^2 / L_{xx}}} = \frac{(\hat{\beta}_1 - \beta_1)\sqrt{L_{xx}}}{\hat{\sigma}} \sim t(n-2). t=σ^2/Lxx​​β^​1​−β1​​=σ^(β^​1​−β1​)Lxx​​​∼t(n−2).

因此，

P(∣(β^1−β1)Lxxσ^∣<tα/2(n−2))=1−α,P\left( \left| \frac{(\hat{\beta}_1 - \beta_1)\sqrt{L_{xx}}}{\hat{\sigma}} \right| < t_{\alpha/2}(n-2) \right) = 1-\alpha, P(∣∣∣∣∣​σ^(β^​1​−β1​)Lxx​​​∣∣∣∣∣​<tα/2​(n−2))=1−α,

P(β^1−tα/2σ^Lxx<β1<β^1+tα/2σ^Lxx)=1−α.P\left( \hat{\beta}_1 - t_{\alpha/2} \frac{\hat{\sigma}}{\sqrt{L_{xx}}} < \beta_1 < \hat{\beta}_1 + t_{\alpha/2} \frac{\hat{\sigma}}{\sqrt{L_{xx}}} \right) = 1-\alpha. P(β^​1​−tα/2​Lxx​​σ^​<β1​<β^​1​+tα/2​Lxx​​σ^​)=1−α.

故 β1\beta_1β1​ 的 1−α1-\alpha1−α 置信区间为

(β^1−tα/2σ^Lxx, β^1+tα/2σ^Lxx).\left( \hat{\beta}_1 - t_{\alpha/2} \frac{\hat{\sigma}}{\sqrt{L_{xx}}},\ \hat{\beta}_1 + t_{\alpha/2} \frac{\hat{\sigma}}{\sqrt{L_{xx}}} \right). (β^​1​−tα/2​Lxx​​σ^​, β^​1​+tα/2​Lxx​​σ^​).

⑦ 单值预测与区间预测：

单值预测：y^0=β^0+β^1x0\hat{y}_0 = \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_0y^​0​=β^​0​+β^​1​x0​，且 E(y^0)=E(y0)=β0+β1x0E(\hat{y}_0) = E(y_0) = \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_0E(y^​0​)=E(y0​)=β0​+β1​x0​。

区间预测（因变量新值的预测区间）：寻找区间 (T1,T2)(T_1, T_2)(T1​,T2​) 使得 P(T1<y0<T2)=1−αP(T_1 < y_0 < T_2) = 1-\alphaP(T1​<y0​<T2​)=1−α。

首先计算 y^0\hat{y}_0y^​0​ 的方差：

y^0=β^0+β^1x0=yˉ−β^1xˉ+β^1x0=∑i=1n(1n+(xi−xˉ)(x0−xˉ)Lxx)yi,Var(y^0)=∑i=1n(1n+(xi−xˉ)(x0−xˉ)Lxx)2Var(yi)=∑i=1n[1n2+2(x0−xˉ)nLxx(xi−xˉ)+(xi−xˉ)2(x0−xˉ)2Lxx2]σ2=(1n+(x0−xˉ)2Lxx)σ2=h00σ2.\begin{aligned} \hat{y}_0 &= \hat{\beta}_0 + \hat{\beta}_1 x_0 = \bar{y} - \hat{\beta}_1 \bar{x} + \hat{\beta}_1 x_0 \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(x_i - \bar{x})(x_0 - \bar{x})}{L_{xx}} \right) y_i, \\[2em] \mathrm{Var}(\hat{y}_0) &= \sum_{i=1}^n \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(x_i - \bar{x})(x_0 - \bar{x})}{L_{xx}} \right)^2 \mathrm{Var}(y_i) \\ &= \sum_{i=1}^n \left[ \frac{1}{n^2} + 2 \frac{(x_0 - \bar{x})}{n L_{xx}} (x_i - \bar{x}) + \frac{(x_i - \bar{x})^2 (x_0 - \bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}^2} \right] \sigma^2 \\ &= \left( \frac{1}{n} + \frac{(x_0 - \bar{x})^2}{L_{xx}} \right) \sigma^2 = h_{00} \sigma^2. \end{aligned} y^​0​Var(y^​0​)​=β^​0​+β^​1​x0​=yˉ​−β^​1​xˉ+β^​1​x0​=i=1∑n​(n1​+Lxx​(xi​−xˉ)(x0​−xˉ)​)yi​,=i=1∑n​(n1​+Lxx​(xi​−xˉ)(x0​−xˉ)​)2Var(yi​)=i=1∑n​[n21​+2nLxx​(x0​−xˉ)​(xi​−xˉ)+Lxx2​(xi​−xˉ)2(x0​−xˉ)2​]σ2=(n1​+Lxx​(x0​−xˉ)2​)σ2=h00​σ2.​

因此 y^0∼N(β0+β1x0, h00σ2)\hat{y}_0 \sim N\bigl( \beta_0 + \beta_1 x_0,\ h_{00} \sigma^2 \bigr)y^​0​∼N(β0​+β1​x0​, h00​σ2)。

由于 y0y_0y0​ 与 y^0\hat{y}_0y^​0​ 相互独立，

Var(y0−y^0)=Var(y0)+Var(y^0)=σ2+h00σ2.\mathrm{Var}(y_0 - \hat{y}_0) = \mathrm{Var}(y_0) + \mathrm{Var}(\hat{y}_0) = \sigma^2 + h_{00} \sigma^2. Var(y0​−y^​0​)=Var(y0​)+Var(y^​0​)=σ2+h00​σ2.
